home.metadataDescription: Split images, generate QR codes, and convert camera RAW files locally in your browser.
home.title: Useful tools,
home.intro: Three focused utilities for creators working with images, print assets, and camera files. No accounts, no uploads, no waiting room.
home.splitDescription: Turn a single image into precise grid tiles for social, print, and layouts.
home.qrDescription: Create crisp SVG and PNG codes for links, print pieces, Wi-Fi, and contact details.
home.rawDescription: Convert camera RAW files privately, directly in your browser.

tools.splitSummary: Build a grid, adjust the crop, and download every tile in one archive.
tools.qrSummary: Create a code, inspect it, and export a clean file for screen or print.
tools.rawSummary: Convert supported camera RAW files to DNG without uploading them anywhere.

seo.privacyLede: Everything is processed on your device, so you can work with private files without creating an account.

split.metadataTitle: Image Splitter — split images into equal tiles
split.metadataDescription: Split images into precise grids locally in your browser for social media, print, and design.
split.drop: or drop it here — it stays on your device
split.gridHere: Your image grid will appear here.
split.tileNote: Every tile is created in this browser and packed into one ZIP.
split.noUpload: No image is uploaded to a server.
split.imageError: This image could not be opened.

qr.metadataTitle: QR Code Generator — SVG and PNG downloads
qr.metadataDescription: Generate QR codes locally in your browser and download print-ready SVG or PNG files.
qr.placeholder: A link, text, Wi-Fi credentials, or contact details
qr.enter: Enter content to generate a code.

raw.metadataTitle: RAW to DNG Converter — private and browser-based
raw.metadataDescription: Convert supported camera RAW files to DNG locally in your browser without uploading your photos.
raw.formats: CR2, CR3, NEF, ARW, RAF, RW2, ORF, and DNG. The conversion happens in your browser.
raw.queueHint: Choose a RAW file to see conversion progress and downloads here.
